policy: This is a per-file evidence inventory, never a ready-to-apply device patch set. Presence, byte equality and diff size do not decide relevance or authorship.

qualcomm_provenance.xiaomi: MiCode README declares LA.UM.8.3.r1-05800-sdm845.0; the tag and commit are pinned, but exact ancestry is not proved
qualcomm_provenance.legacy: Exact Qualcomm base is not established; comparisons against the Xiaomi-declared tag include BSP/version/later changes

limits: Byte equality is not hardware validation
A changed file is not automatically a device patch or a crDroid-authored fix
Linux version-matched controls are not ancestry proofs
No target HAL/vendor ABI is selected by this inventory
